socAi.title: SOC-AI Configuration
socAi.subtitle: Configure the AI agent that triages alerts and powers the operations assistant.

provider.label: Provider
provider.hint: Selects the wire format. Anything other than Anthropic uses the OpenAI-compatible API.

model.label: Model
model.hint: Model identifier exposed by the provider.

url.label: API URL
url.hint: Leave empty to use the provider's default endpoint.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.setHint: A key is stored. Leave blank to keep it.

authType.label: Authentication type
authType.hint: How credentials are sent to your gateway.

authHeaderName.label: Auth header name
authHeaderName.hint: Header carrying the key (e.g. api-key for Azure).

authToken.label: Bearer token
authToken.setHint: A token is stored. Leave blank to keep it.

customHeaders.label: Custom headers
customHeaders.hint: Extra headers sent with every request. Values are encrypted; "*****" keeps the stored one.

maxToolIterations.label: Max tool iterations
maxToolIterations.hint: Cap on the agent's plan -> tool -> observe loop.

autoAnalyze.label: Auto-analyze alerts
autoAnalyze.hint: Triage incoming alerts in real time.

allowIncidents.label: Allow managing incidents
allowIncidents.hint: The triage agent may create or update incidents when it decides an alert warrants one.

changeAlertStatus.label: Change alert status
changeAlertStatus.hint: Let the agent set an alert's status during triage.

automaticIncidentCreation.label: Create incidents
automaticIncidentCreation.hint: Let the agent open incidents from triaged alerts.

allowedWriteTools.label: Allowed write tools
allowedWriteTools.hint: One MCP tool name per line the triage agent may use (e.g. alerts.update_status). Notes are always allowed.

applyTags.label: Apply tags
applyTags.hint: Let the agent tag alerts during triage.

note.azure: Paste your full Azure deployment endpoint as the URL; the model is your deployment name. Auth uses the api-key header.
note.ollama: Point the URL at your Ollama host. No API key is needed for a local instance.
note.custom: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Set the URL, auth and any extra headers your gateway needs.
note.threatwinds: Uses your UTMStack license automatically — no API key needed. Billed through your ThreatWinds subscription.

chat.title: SOC Assistant
chat.empty: Ask anything about your alerts, detections or the console — I can investigate and act on the SIEM.
chat.suggestion: how many open alerts, grouped by adversary?

inheritance.inherited: Following the instance default. Saving here gives this tenant its own configuration.
inheritance.own: This tenant has its own configuration.

allowance.title: AI allowance today
allowance.denied: requests — the AI is not available to this tenant
allowance.hint: Set by whoever runs the instance. It resets at midnight UTC.
